mcq_questions.description: ﻿∫ex(1+x)cos⁡2(xex)dx∫1cos⁡2zdz=∫sec⁡2zdz=tan⁡z+c=tan⁡(xex)+c\int\frac{e^{x}(1+x)}{\cos^{2}(xe^{x})}dx \\ \int \frac{1}{\cos^2 z} dz \\ = \int \sec^2 z dz = \tan z + c \\ = \tan(xe^x) + c∫cos2(xex)ex(1+x)​dx∫cos2z1​dz=∫sec2zdz=tanz+c=tan(xex)+c﻿ ﻿ধরি,xex=z⇒xex+ex=dzdx⇒ex(1+x)=dzdx\\ \\ \text{ধরি,} \\ xe^x = z \\ \Rightarrow xe^x + e^x = \frac{dz}{dx} \\ \Rightarrow e^x (1 + x) = \frac{dz}{dx}ধরি,xex=z⇒xex+ex=dxdz​⇒ex(1+x)=dxdz​﻿

mcq_questions.description: ﻿∫01x dx1+x4=A=∫01x dx1+(x2)2=12∫0111+z2 dz=12[tan⁡−1z]01=12(tan⁡−11−0)=12×π4=π8\int_{0}^{1}\frac{x\,dx}{1+x^{4}} = A \\ = \int_{0}^{1}\frac{x\,dx}{1+(x^{2})^{2}} \\ = \frac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{1}\frac{1}{1+z^{2}}\,dz = \frac{1}{2}[\tan^{-1}z]_{0}^{1} = \frac{1}{2}(\tan^{-1}1 - 0) = \frac{1}{2}\times\frac{\pi}{4} = \frac{\pi}{8}∫01​1+x4xdx​=A=∫01​1+(x2)2xdx​=21​∫01​1+z21​dz=21​[tan−1z]01​=21​(tan−11−0)=21​×4π​=8π​﻿
